resources.string: Required to show the mirror over other apps.
Enable Middor Touch in Android Accessibility settings for touch controls. Not needed for view-only mirroring. If it stops working after an update, turn it off and on.
Optional. Shows a notification you can tap to close the mirror.
Choose System, Light, or Dark. This does not change the mirrored app.
Opens screen-sharing setup on launch. You still choose the app to mirror.
Mirrors the image and touch positions left to right. Restart to apply.
Rotates the image and touch positions 180°. Restart to apply.
Shows a circle where you touch the mirror. Off by default.
Sets how long replayed taps are held. Other gestures keep their timing.
Places the close button in the selected corner, unaffected by flipping or rotation. Restart to apply.
Hides the status and navigation bars. Restart after changing this setting or rotating your device.
Delays the screen-sharing picker after Start or Start on Launch.

Enable Middor Touch in Android Accessibility settings to tap and swipe the mirror. Gestures replay after you lift your fingers. Turning this off makes the mirror view-only and blocks touches to the hidden app. Restart to apply.
Touch controls stopped. Restart the mirror.

Enables touch controls by intercepting and replaying your gestures while mirroring. Does not read accessibility window content or store or share gesture data. Turn off touch controls or this service to stop replay.
